definitions.explanation: The act of sleeping past one's intended wake-up time or later than usual.
A person who habitually sleeps late or has trouble waking up on time.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{朝寝坊|あさねぼう}をして{遅刻|ちこく}した。
examples.english: I overslept today and was late.
examples.notes: 朝寝坊をする is the common verb phrase for 'to oversleep'

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}は{朝寝坊|あさねぼう}で、いつも{母|はは}に{起|お}こされる。
examples.english: My younger brother is a late riser and always has to be woken up by our mother.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}くらい{朝寝坊|あさねぼう}したい。
examples.english: I want to sleep in at least on my days off.

notes:
{朝寝坊|あさねぼう} refers to both the act of oversleeping and a person who oversleeps habitually.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {朝寝坊|あさねぼう}をする (to oversleep)
- {朝寝坊|あさねぼう}な{人|ひと} (a late riser - using na-adjective form)

ANTONYM:
- {早起|はやお}き (early rising, early riser)
